notes.content:

notes.title: DTG Remake Development Status Report 25.06.2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/dffdebf611aa8229b684dbfb1292068a62359745.png

The remake. What do you expect?

What will await you is an exciting story told by the surrounding area.
The story is about a young man suffering from depression.
The game leaves you open to the possibility of how the story will end.

The quirks of the original game are remedied with the remake as much as possible.

That would be:

 The bad english 

 The players who were affected by some images and videos now have the possibility to choose if they want to see this content 
[Cencored Version Abitlity]
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/b2a1492b17bbcfc89cd108fd52f597fd8bef200e.png

 The quite uninhibited world has now been made more interactive and more interesting in the context is the game is not so boring and you have things to do [Added Gamplay Elements]


Since several voices have spoken against the "One way doors" I decided to remove them

The generic quality of the game
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/f69c29a70c05533e3c5f35fa8671aae9f89cf5c1.png


Generally a lot of content has been added
which in general enrich the story and the environment



Technical improvements compared to the original game

 Save and Load System 

 Diary System 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/fa2e7ae67d8da1f0b00476301cf4a76ec589784e.png

 Fantastic graphics
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/5d4c579b0b386dcaf67a7e75e1d4449e5a464e84.png 

 The environment is much more alive
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/01ee5146092a47860cb1b2b10d26f8045cc64c61.png

 Better physics, interactions, movement, sound and much more
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/374edd81f6477d1811dfa7c32d54cfd3c464f2dd.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/8f7126a8503eb1ac22403782cfe54a2e8b8f75bc.png




System Requirements Minimum:

 QuadCore CPU
 Nvidia GTX 1050 or similar with min 2 GB Ram
 8 GB Ram

 DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 on Windows
 OpenGL Core 4.1+/ES3.0+ on Windows
 .net 4.x support

Supported Aspect Ratio
 4:3
 3:2
 16:9
 16:10
